name: U-49900
metabolism: There is not much information on how the U-47700 series is broken down or cleared from the body. Judging by the chemistry, the likely routes are taking the alkyl group off and adding a hydroxyl group to the cyclohexyl ring. A study of U-49900 found that N-desethyl-U-49900 was the main product in the lab, while N,N-didesethyl-N-desmethyl-U-49900 was the most plentiful in a urine sample. U-47700 and U-49900 seem to go the same way, which means they share breakdown products: N,N-didesmethyl-U-47700 and N,N-didesethyl-U-49900 have the same formula and structure, and both break down to 3,4-dichloro-N-(2-aminocyclohexyl)-N-methylbenzamide.
